description: Implementation of the ClientGrainLocator class which implements IGrainLocator for locating client grains using an in-memory distributed directory in Orleans Runtime.

classes.name: ClientGrainLocator
classes.description: Implements IGrainLocator to locate client grains using in-memory directory, with methods for lookup, cache management, and registration attempts that throw exceptions.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Performs asynchronous lookup for a GrainId, returning its address if found.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException as client grains cannot be registered explicitly.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Throws InvalidOperationException as client grains cannot be unregistered explicitly.

methods.name: TryLookupInCache
methods.description: Attempts to find the address of a GrainId in the local cache.
